dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures display high-contrast light perimeters against a dark background. The geometry features sharp inner transitions from dark cores to light rings, with slightly more diffused outer edges transitioning back to the dark dorsal fur.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters; small, punctate light spots lacking internal gradients are distributed sparsely, primarily observed in the anterior-dorsal and posterior-lateral regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form a scalene triangle in the mid-body region, while a cluster of four rings on the posterior-lateral flank forms an irregular quadrilateral.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique tripartite grouping of overlapping annuli creates a singular complex pattern on the mid-posterior lateral surface.
